newsitem.title: MALTA: MALTA GRANTS AUSTRIAN BANK LICENCE.
newsitem.headline: MALTA GRANTS AUSTRIAN BANK LICENCE.

text.p: Malta has granted Austrian Raiffeisen Malta Bank a licence to carry out business in foreign currency with non-residents only, the Central Bank said on Wednesday.

The licence is the first to be issued since the Labour government of Prime Minister Alfred Sant took office after the October 26 election. The Labour party had supported legislation moved by the former Nationalist government to promote the setting up of offshore banks in the Mediterranean island.
The bank is a subsidiary of Raiffeisen Zentralbank Oesterreich AG, a member of the Raiffeisen banking group.
Seven other offshore banks are registered in Malta.
